columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year as a number (2026 = FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027); the order field for prior-year comparisons (offset -1).
columns.name: Fiscal Year Number

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the P&L year, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027 (in progress, H1 closed 30-Sep-2026), FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026 (the latest complete year).
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: True for FY2026, the fiscal year containing the as-of date 30-Sep-2026 ("this fiscal year").
columns.name: Is Latest Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: True for complete fiscal years (FY2024, FY2025); false for FY2026 to date (Apr-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Is Full Year

columns.comment: True when the client's ROE for the year is below the 10% ROE hurdle; null without capital (no lending).
columns.name: Below ROE Hurdle

columns.comment: True when the client's RoRWA for the year is below the 1.2% hurdle (also meant by "below the 8% hurdle"); null without RWA.
columns.name: Below RoRWA Hurdle

columns.comment: True when credit cost exceeds 30% of revenue in the year (dim_threshold CREDIT_COST_SHARE_HIGH).
columns.name: Credit Cost Above 30%

columns.comment: True when the client consumed RWA / capital in the year (a credit relationship); ROE is undefined otherwise.
columns.name: Has Capital

columns.comment: Products held at the end of the period, bucketed - 0 products, 1 product, 2 products, 3-4, 5-7, 8+ products.
columns.name: Product Count Bucket

columns.comment: Total revenue in USD for the fiscal year (NII + fees + trading incl. other TB and advisory; FY2026 = Apr-Sep).
columns.name: Revenue USD

columns.comment: Allocated operating cost (cost to serve) in USD for the fiscal year.
columns.name: Opex USD

columns.comment: Credit cost = expected loss in USD for the fiscal year.
columns.name: Credit Cost USD

columns.comment: Revenue - opex - credit cost in USD (= net contribution).
columns.name: Pre-Tax Profit USD

columns.comment: Tax at the statutory rate of the coverage office on positive pre-tax profit, USD.
columns.name: Tax USD

columns.comment: Net income in USD for the fiscal year = pre-tax profit - tax (FY2026 = six months).
columns.name: Net Income USD

columns.comment: Net income annualised in USD (FY2026 x 2) - the ROE numerator.
columns.name: Net Income Annualised USD

columns.comment: Average capital allocated over the year at 12.5% of RWA, in USD (latest fiscal year of the selection).
columns.name: Allocated Capital USD

columns.comment: Average risk-weighted assets over the year in USD (latest fiscal year of the selection).
columns.name: Average RWA USD

columns.comment: Return on allocated capital = annualised net income / average allocated capital (fraction; hurdle 10%). Extreme for deposit-rich clients with little capital - compare with Median Client ROE.
columns.name: ROE %

columns.comment: Median of the clients' ROE (winsorised -25%..100%, credit clients only) - the typical relationship return.
columns.name: Median Client ROE %

columns.comment: The configured ROE hurdle from gold.dim_threshold (ROE_HURDLE, 0.10 = 10%, the cost of equity).
columns.name: ROE Hurdle %

columns.comment: ROE minus the hurdle (fraction; -0.03 = 3 percentage points below the 10% hurdle).
columns.name: Hurdle Gap pts

columns.comment: Clients with revenue or capital in the year (latest fiscal year of the selection).
columns.name: Clients

columns.comment: Credit clients whose ROE for the year is below the 10% hurdle (latest fiscal year of the selection).
columns.name: Clients Below Hurdle

columns.comment: EAD at the end of the year of the clients below the ROE hurdle, USD (latest fiscal year of the selection).
columns.name: Exposure Below Hurdle USD

columns.comment: Annualised relationship net profit / average RWA (fraction; hurdle 1.2%) - the same basis as mv_client_profitability.
columns.name: RoRWA %

columns.comment: Annualised relationship net profit / average economic capital (fraction; hurdle 12%).
columns.name: RAROC %

columns.comment: Credit cost as a share of revenue (fraction; above 0.30 = high).
columns.name: Credit Cost to Revenue %

columns.comment: Clients whose credit cost exceeded 30% of revenue in the year (latest fiscal year of the selection).
columns.name: Clients With High Credit Cost

columns.comment: Net income minus the 10% cost of the allocated capital, USD (negative = value-destroying).
columns.name: Economic Profit USD

comment: ROE waterfall of SMBC APAC clients by fiscal year (FY2024, FY2025, FY2026 to date = Apr-Sep 2026; USD): revenue, operating expense, credit cost (expected loss), pre-tax profit, tax, net income, allocated capital (12.5% of RWA) and ROE vs the 10% hurdle (gold.dim_threshold), hurdle gap, clients and exposure below hurdle, credit cost / revenue, RoRWA and RAROC (hurdle basis). Filter ONE Fiscal Year for amounts; FY2026 flows are six months while ratios are annualised. ROE % = annualised net income / allocated capital (ratio of sums): deposit-rich clients and groups with little capital show very high ROE - rank groups with a capital floor or read Median Client ROE. Grain: one row per golden client x fiscal year (gold.fact_client_pnl_waterfall_annual).
